title: Turn View
description: The front camera in the instrument cluster's widget with the next turn drawn on the road as chevrons and a turn card, from BMW Maps, Apple CarPlay or Android Auto. Pick Turn View in the cluster's widget menu, or let it pop up by itself 500, 250, 100 or 50 m before each turn; calibrate the camera once on a straight road. Needs the Turn View tool from the same source and Cluster renderer from robertnisipeanu/idrive-apps (0.4.1 or newer). iDrive 8 only.
